scientific_question: Can generated whole-product graphs be constrained to reaction-family- and precursor-role-specific ring morphology observed in the training fold without selecting a finite component vocabulary?
nonclaims: Training-supported local ring morphology is not synthesis success, stability, safety, activity or route closure.
An unsupported ring closure is an abstention under this bounded policy, not proof that the structure is chemically impossible.
The policy stores no component identity, component fingerprint or complete molecular fragment.
This policy does not replace the frozen raw exact-L1 result and does not select candidates.
